Instrument.name: Apple iPhone 17
Instrument.description:
The Apple iPhone 17 is a premium smartphone featuring an aluminum frame and a color-infused, frosted glass back. It is equipped with a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display that integrates 120Hz ProMotion fluid scrolling, Always-On functionality, and a protective Ceramic Shield 2 front glass built for high scratch resistance. The device features a 48MP Dual Fusion rear camera system, composed of a main lens with optical-quality 2x zoom and an ultra-wide lens, complemented by a landscape-capable 18MP Center Stage front-facing selfie camera.
Internally, the device runs on the A19 chip, which features a 6-core CPU, a 5-core GPU, and a 16-core Neural Engine designed to seamlessly process local AI workflows and high-end gaming. Power efficiency is enhanced by a custom N1 networking chip that supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity. Starting at a base storage capacity of 256GB, the phone includes a physical Camera Control button, an IP68 water-resistance rating, and a battery engineered for all-day usage with up to 30 hours of video playback.
This is a "multi-instance" and "multi-host" instrument, meaning not a specific instrument but rather a type or model of instrument that may be used many times across one or more missions and is not associated with any specific host. Each of these instruments are functionally identical, although they may have instance-specific calibration information.
